**Forward Deployed Engineer \| Palantir\-style FDE at a software holdco backed by the Collisons, General Catalyst \& D1 \| New York / SF / Toronto (Hybrid) \| $185K–$240K base** 




  





 We've partnered with a new kind of software holding company: one that buys great vertical\-market software businesses and holds them permanently, then grows them with agentic AI rather than financial engineering. They recently closed a $250M Series B from an exceptional roster, including General Catalyst, D1 Capital, CPMG, Sator Grove and the family offices of some of tech's most successful founders, among them Patrick and John Collison, Tony Xu, Eric Glyman and Karim Atiyeh. The founders have done it before: one a former President of Instacart, the other a former Sequoia partner. They run on permanent, committed capital with no pressure to sell, and one clear thesis, scale through software, not headcount.
 



  





 This is a rare Palantir\-style Forward Deployed Engineer role, and the leverage is unusual. You won't write decks. You'll drop into a company that already has customers and revenue, work out which two or three workflows agentic software can genuinely fix, then build it: integrations, prompts, evals, the interface people actually use. You ship it into live operations, tune the autonomy tiers until it runs without anyone hovering, and hand it off clean. Then you write down what you learned, and the next deployment in that vertical goes faster because you did the work first. The difference from selling software is that the customer is a company they own, so if it doesn't work, they feel it directly.
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will:
 



  





 Drop into a portfolio company, learn how it actually runs, earn the operators' trust, and find the two or three highest\-leverage workflows for agentic software.
 



 Build the wedge: the integrations, prompts, evals and UI to land the first agentic loop on the core platform.
 



 Operate and tune deployed systems after launch, adjusting autonomy tiers and handing off cleanly once stable.
 



 Act as the technical face to portfolio\-company GMs, setting expectations and making the system their leverage.
 



 Bring patterns back to HQ and codify them into playbooks that speed up every future deployment in the vertical.
 



  





 About You
 



  





 You have four to six years of experience, with three the absolute floor and we mean it. Big Tech alone won't clear the bar; the strongest profiles pair a recognisable company with real high\-growth startup experience.
 



 You have genuine tenure at a startup people have heard of, and stayed long enough to watch your own decisions play out. A string of sub\-year stints is the most common reason strong engineers get passed on here.
 



 You can own delivery solo, database through to screen: TypeScript or Python on the backend, React on the frontend, SQL. Specialists get blocked constantly in this role.
 



 You have shipped production LLM or agentic software that external users depended on, with evals, autonomy gating and outcome tracking, not prototypes or demos.
 



 You build with AI dev tools every day and have opinions about them, whether that's Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot or MCP servers. If you don't work this way, the pace will be uncomfortable.
 



 You have operator instincts: you can read a P\&L, sit with a GM who has never written code, disagree, be right, and leave with a scoped technical problem.
 



 You are based in or willing to relocate to New York, San Francisco or Toronto, comfortable with at least three days a week in office plus two to three days travelling to portfolio sites. Open to visa transfers including OPT and H\-1B, with relocation help.
 



  





 The interview will ask you to walk through the hardest technical decision you've made: the decision, the option you turned down, and why. Come ready to go three layers into something you built. The team is hiring several engineers and moving quickly. If you want to ship agentic software into live operations and own the outcomes across an entire portfolio, apply now or send your CV directly to will@inventurerecruitment.com.

**Job Description:**
 The IT Data Analyst provides data, reporting, and analytics support across TTI’s Carolina businesses — Consumer Power Tools (CPT), Outdoor Power Equipment (OPE), and Floor Care (FC) — partnering with the Data Analytics \& Information Engineering (DAIE) team and business stakeholders to build, maintain, and improve Power BI reports, Snowflake transformation layers, and other data ingestion and decision\-support tools. This role provides general analytical support balanced across all three business units, with workload and priorities shifting over time based on business needs. The position also implements AI\-enabled solutions — such as Snowflake Cortex Analyst and Cortex Agents, Copilot agents, and related conversational or agentic tools — for business units to consume and utilize directly. The position combines core SQL and Power BI skills with a strong interest in automation and AI\-assisted development, and reports to the BI Manager.
   

  

**Responsibilities / Skills**
* Provides day\-to\-day data analytics, reporting, and troubleshooting support across the CPT, OPE, and FC business units, resolving incidents and enhancement requests routed through ServiceNow.
* Serves as a key point of contact for data and reporting needs across the CPT, OPE, and FC business units, supporting efforts to document, stabilize, and modernize existing reports, data models, and data processes.
* Writes, tests, and troubleshoots SQL queries to access, validate, and prepare data for reporting, analytics, and automation across multiple source systems.
* Builds, maintains, and enhances Power BI reports, dashboards, and semantic models that support business decision\-making for CPT, OPE, and FC stakeholders.
* Partners with business users to gather requirements, clarify report specifications, and translate business questions into working analytics solutions.
* Supports migration and consolidation of legacy reporting environments, including moving business unit workspaces and reports into current\-state Power BI apps, and helps identify and retire duplicate or unused reports.
* Assists with Snowflake data preparation, transformation, and semantic model refresh processes; contributes to dbt\-based transformation work as skills develop.
* Uses AI coding agents and related tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to accelerate development, testing, debugging, and documentation of reports, queries, and automation.
* Implements AI\-enabled solutions for business unit stakeholders to consume and utilize directly, such as Snowflake Cortex Analyst and Cortex Agents, Copilot agents, and similar conversational or agentic tools that extend self\-service access to data and reporting.
* Monitors scheduled data refreshes and automated processes, troubleshooting failures and escalating as needed to minimize business disruption.
* Documents data sources, report logic, calculations, and processes to build institutional knowledge and reduce single points of failure.
* Tracks and prioritizes incoming tickets and tasks in ServiceNow, balancing workload across CPT, OPE, and FC analytics needs.
* Collaborates with other DAIE team members, IT, and business stakeholders to ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, secure, and aligned to enterprise standards.
* Performs other related duties as assigned.


**This job description is intended to be illustrative of the position's duties and should not be construed to be an exhaustive statement of the essential functions of the job.**
**CRITICAL SUCCESS FACTORS**
* Analytical Skills – ability to understand data, write and interpret SQL, evaluate data quality, build reporting logic, and translate findings into practical recommendations.
* Technical Curiosity – genuine interest in Power BI, Snowflake, automation, and AI\-assisted development tools; willingness to learn quickly and apply new capabilities.
* Business Partnership – ability to build credibility with business stakeholders across multiple business units, understand functional needs, and manage expectations.
* Ownership \& Follow\-Through – ability to take end\-to\-end responsibility for assigned tickets and projects across business units, including stabilizing and modernizing data environments as needed.
* Communication Skills – ability to explain technical concepts, project updates, and data issues clearly to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge.
* Problem Solving – ability to break down ambiguous data and reporting issues, troubleshoot root causes, and recommend solutions that can be implemented and sustained.
* Prioritization \& Adaptability – ability to manage a varied workload across CPT, OPE, and FC business units, adjusting focus as priorities and business needs shift.
* Collaboration \& Independence – ability to work effectively alone or with cross\-functional teams, balancing self\-directed execution with strong teamwork.


**Education And Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in business, computer science, or a related discipline; OR an MBA with a concentration in data analytics; OR a bachelor’s degree in any discipline combined with equivalent professional experience, is required.
* Proficiency with SQL is required, including the ability to write, troubleshoot, and optimize queries for reporting, analytics, and data preparation.
* Proficiency with Power BI is required, including report and dashboard development, data modeling, and DAX in a business setting.
* Experience with Python is strongly preferred.
* Experience with, or strong interest in, using AI coding agents (e.g., GitHub Copilot) to support development, testing, and documentation work is a strong preference.
* Experience with, or strong interest in, implementing AI\-enabled tools for business consumption (e.g., Snowflake Cortex Analyst/Agents, Copilot agents, or similar conversational/agentic solutions) is a strong preference.
* Experience with Snowflake and dbt is a plus.
* Experience with Azure Data Factory, Prefect, Kubernetes, or Docker is a plus.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across the CPT, OPE, and FC business units while maintaining consistent, broad\-based analytics support.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and perform well under pressure.
* Ability to work independently and as an integral part of a cross\-functional team.


**Other Requirements**
* Ability to travel (post\-COVID) up to 10%. It is anticipated this position will travel 0\-10%


**PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:** 
*if applicable,* 
*select one \& change pounds*
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 30 pounds at times.
